name: automate-ui-playwright
description: Playwright UI automation with POM, selectors, and custom fixtures

scripts.metrics:history:
node -e "const data = require('./metrics/metrics-history.json'); console.log('
📊 METRICS HISTORY SUMMARY
' + '='.repeat(50)); data.forEach((m, i) => console.log(`[${i + 1}] ${m.date} | Pass: ${m.passRate}% | Time: ${m.executionTimeMin}min | Flaky: ${m.flaky}`)); console.log('='.repeat(50) + '
');"
